newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commission selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commission selling.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended lower on commission house selling, traders said.

"RBC-DS was a big seller of the July late in the day, Cargill sold November and UGG sold 250 July-Aug," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +6.57 Monday from +3.97 Friday. About 200 July-Nov spread at $35, July-Aug $0.50. Volume was light.
Japan bought 2,000 tonnes canola overnight, sources said.
July canola lost $2.10 to close at $407.80, August down $2.40 to $407.10, November fell $3.40 to $374.30. July flax lost $0.20 to $331 after setting a new contract low at $329.50.

July western barley rose $0.90 to $133.40 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold and October closed up $0.60 at $134.50, traders said. December rose $0.60 to $135.60 with PCTS buying, a trader said. Volume was 450 lots.
AWP sold July wheat up $0.80 late at $159.80 to Midland Walwyn, commercials sold December up $0.30 to $161, traders said. Twenty July-Dec spread at $1. Volume was 200 lots.
PCTS sold December feed peas up US$0.70 to US$189.20. Volume was 80 lots. Oats did not trade.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
